result.summary: Found several visual issues: a broken discount badge (-100%), truncated restaurant names, and awkward overlapping labels on food images.

issues.description: The pizza card shows a '-100%' badge, which looks incorrect or broken for a discount/offer label.
issues.suggestion: Verify the discount logic and display a sensible value (e.g. '-20%') or hide the badge when the value is invalid.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated with missing letters at the end of the card.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, use a responsive ellipsis, or widen the card so the full name is readable.

issues.description: Delivery time pills (e.g. '15–25 min') sit overlapping the bottom of the food images in a way that can obscure the artwork.
issues.suggestion: Add more padding/margin or place the time badge in a clearer overlay area so it does not cover key parts of the image.

issues.description: Category filter chips row ends with a partially visible empty chip on the far right, which can look like a layout glitch beyond normal carousel clipping.
issues.suggestion: Ensure chip spacing and horizontal inset so only intentional content peeks at the edge, or add consistent end padding.
